dct_description_sm: The objectives if this multi-year initiative was to develop adaptation plans that address climate change vulnerabilities in the subsistence economies of three communities in the Inuvialuit Settlement Region through collaboration with community members, local stakeholders, scientists, and policy makers. This project developed community-specific climate change adaptation action plans for Ulukhaktok, Paulatuk, and Aklavik in the Northwest Territories.

dct_title_s: Adaptation Planning for Climate Change in Ulukhaktok, Paulatuk, and Aklavik, NWT
